0: Hwei is High difficulty and Support/Mage: Subject: Serenity opens Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection and Stirring Lights; Spiraling Despair creates an expanding painting that slows and damages enemies before exploding. Renata Glasc is High difficulty and Support/Mage: Bailout delays an ally’s death and can save them after a takedown; Hostile Takeover makes enemies Berserk.
1: Ezreal is a Medium-difficulty Marksman/Mage: Arcane Shift teleports him and fires a homing bolt, while a Mystic Shot hit reduces all cooldowns slightly. Lucian is a Medium-difficulty Marksman/Assassin: Relentless Pursuit is a short dash, and Lightslinger attacks reduce its cooldown; using an ability makes his next attack a double-shot.
2: I recommend Malphite, rated Low: Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of maximum Health and recharges after avoiding hits; Unstoppable Force launches him into enemies and knocks them into the air. Rammus is Medium: Defensive Ball Curl increases Armor and Magic Resistance and returns attack damage; Soaring Slam damages and slows an area, adding a central knock-up when cast during Powerball.
3: The top five in order are Miss Fortune, Lux, Ahri, Akali, Ezreal. Miss Fortune has 24 appearances including the base, with Cowgirl Miss Fortune and Waterloo Miss Fortune among the non-base skins. Lux has 23 appearances including the base, with Sorceress Lux and Spellthief Lux among the non-base skins.
5: The Ruined King is Viego, a Fighter/Assassin of Medium difficulty. Viego’s Sovereign’s Domination lets him attack a defeated enemy’s wraith to possess their body temporarily, heal for a percentage of its maximum health and gain basic abilities and items; their ultimate is replaced by a free cast of his own. Viego’s Heartbreaker teleports him to a nearby location, executes the target and knocks away that target’s allies. Viego’s Harrowed Path creates mist around terrain, granting camouflage, Move Speed and Attack Speed.
6: Mel has 3 appearances: Mel, Arcane Councilor Mel and Prestige Winterblessed Mel; her Mage/Support roles and Medium difficulty make her the easier choice. Ambessa has 3 appearances: Ambessa, Chosen of the Wolf Ambessa and T1 Ambessa; there is no Arcane-named skin in this list, and her Fighter/Assassin roles have High difficulty.
7: Drakehound’s Step, the passive, lets Ambessa dash after casting when given an attack or movement command, improving the next attack and refunding energy. Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam: hitting an enemy unlocks the transformed second cast. Repudiation: W grants a shield and does increased damage if it blocks non-minion damage while bracing. Lacerate: E slows nearby enemies and strikes a second time at the end of a passive dash. Public Execution: R blinks to the farthest enemy champion on the chosen line, suppresses them and then stuns them with the slam.
8: Vow of the First Lands: the passive makes Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage. Cultivation of Spirit: Q grants Attack Speed and bonus damage On-Hit, and attacks spread to nearby enemies. Arc of Judgment / Arc of Ruin: W normally fires a spinning prayer bead, changing to a laser in the empowered state; both damage and slow. Kanmei’s Steps / Untouchable Shadow: E normally grants Move Speed and makes Yunara Ghosted, changing to a directional dash. Transcend One’s Self: R enters the Transcendent State and upgrades the basic abilities.
10: Caitlyn has Pulsefire Caitlyn, is a Marksman of Medium difficulty and meets the limit. Ezreal has Pulsefire Ezreal, is a Marksman/Mage of Medium difficulty and is eligible. Thresh has Pulsefire Thresh, is Support/Tank of High difficulty and is excluded by the limit.
11: League of Legends Patch 26.19 Notes, September 22, 2026: Aatrox’s W, Infernal Chains, changes cooldowns from 20 / 18 / 16 / 14 / 12 seconds to 18 / 16.5 / 15 / 13.5 / 12 seconds. League of Legends Patch 26.18 Notes, September 9, 2026: Kassadin’s Q, Null Sphere, changes the AP ratio from 70% to 80%.
12: Aatrox’s Infernal Chains damages the first enemy hit and can pull a champion or large monster back to the impact area if it remains there. The cooldown changes from 20 / 18 / 16 / 14 / 12 seconds to 18 / 16.5 / 15 / 13.5 / 12 seconds: rank one saves 2 seconds and rank five has zero seconds of reduction.
14: The initial Team Voice in League announcement says Riot revisited voice after advances in technology for identifying bad actors made its safety and reliability standards attainable. The later TL;DW update ties speaking access to Honor level and requires appropriate moderation; rollout starts in NA and Oceania in Patch 26.20, with other regions dependent on readiness.
15: “Modernizing the Monk” is by The ASU Team; an ASU is an art and sustainability update, including visual and animation work. Lee Sin’s W, Safeguard / Iron Will, provides a dash and shield followed by Life Steal and Spell Vamp. Lee Sin’s R, Dragon’s Rage, is a powerful kick that knocks the target back, damaging that target and enemies it collides with; those enemies are knocked up.
16: The Demacian champions added are Poppy, Xin Zhao, Shyvana, Galio and Fiora; all five appear in the Classic roster. Classic’s listed launch is July 29, 2026 at 11:00 am PT, and access is through downloading Riot Client / League of Legends.
17: Standard League, Patch 26.18: Kassadin’s Q, Null Sphere, AP ratio rises from 70% to 80%; R, Riftwalk, base damage changes from 70 / 90 / 110 to 80 / 95 / 110. League Classic, Patch 26.19: Q’s AP ratio changes from 60% to 70%, while R range increases from 600 to 700. These are different modes, not sequential changes to one shared ruleset.
18: Previously on Star Guardian tells the First Star’s universe and its protectors’ story, including Lux, Ahri and Zoe. The Council Archives Primer concerns Piltover and Arcane characters Jayce, Vi, Caitlyn and Jinx; it introduces an interactive experience in the League client, rather than the Star Guardian recap.
19: The original “/dev: Vanguard x LoL” is by mirageofpenguins, dated April 11, 2024. The retrospective, also by mirageofpenguins and dated August 22, 2024, reports over 175,000 accounts banned for cheating and a Ranked scripting rate below 1%; it separately describes a cleanup of 3.5 million unsold bot accounts.
26: Baron grants bonus attack damage, ability power, empowered recall and stronger nearby minions. Push turrets behind minions to avoid damage. Destroying an inhibitor produces super minions in that lane until the inhibitor respawns. Master Yi’s Alpha Strike makes him untargetable while hitting multiple nearby enemies; Meditate restores health while reducing incoming damage.
27: Bot lane needs early protection to gain enough gold and experience to carry later. Sona’s Aria of Perseverance heals her and a nearby wounded ally and provides a temporary aura shield; Crescendo stuns enemies. Soraka’s Astral Infusion heals another ally at the cost of some of her own health; Wish heals all allied champions.
28: Sona is Support/Mage, Medium difficulty; the matching skins are Pentakill Sona, DJ Sona and Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Sona. Karthus is a Mage, Medium difficulty; the matching skins are Pentakill Karthus and Pentakill III: Lost Chapter Karthus, with no DJ option. Sona is the choice if a DJ skin is essential.
29: We Are More is the passive: it spawns packmates that attack the targets of Naafiri’s attacks and abilities. The Call of the Pack, W, makes her Untargetable, spawns additional packmates and grants Move Speed and Attack Damage. Eviscerate, E, dashes and damages enemies while recalling and fully healing the packmates. Hounds’ Pursuit, R, dashes to a champion; a takedown reveals nearby enemies and allows one recast, and the second cast grants a shield.
